_readme: THE PIXEL FLOOR (rule 105), re-measured from his packs by tools/bohemia_pixel_floor.py --measure; painted = the box of pixels at least half opaque. Read by gates/pixel_floor_gate.py.

tile.from: 10th percentile of 736 road, ground and marking pieces

building.from: 10th percentile of 348 settlement and door pieces

thing.from: the smallest of 784 props he bought

vehicle.from: the median of 784 props (a car or a crate)

portrait.from: the median canvas of 736 pack tiles

person.from: ruling: the 112 box, about 100 painted; records/BOHEMIA_THE_BODY_IN_METERS_10_13_26.md 98 px = 1.72 m

icon.from: ruling: the smallest prop canvas, 29 by 36, rounded up

marker.from: ruling: the smallest ground canvas, 40 by 38

beast.from: the smallest of 784 props he bought (a beast is held to the smallest thing)

thumb.from: ruling: the smallest prop canvas, 29 by 36, rounded up (a face's thumb is icon-sized, law 8/28)
